0022600181.text: The Timberwolves (4-3, 10th in the West) visit the Rockets (6-1, 2nd in the West) in a matchup where Houston comes in on a six-game... no, a win streak of one, having won its last ten at 6-1, while Minnesota has lost its last game and sits 1 game back in the Northwest. Minnesota is missing Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery), Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery) and Terrence Shannon Jr. (hip bruise), while Houston is without Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain). The Timberwolves won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 136-132 win in Houston on April 10, 2026, and the two teams have not yet played each other in 2026-27.
